result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by adding the required 90-day software warranty, 30-day services warranty, applicable performance standards, and repair/replacement/refund remedies. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the longer durations, a warranty covering all deliverables, compliance with laws, and a no-malicious-code warranty. The addition is targeted and does not contradict the existing disclaimer, although the phrasing concerning replacement of Services and a warranty lasting after services are performed is somewhat awkward.
